ITQAN:v3p103/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p103/r9.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p103/r9.claim: A noun for an agent or object can stand for the action: كاذبة means denial, and المفتون means affliction, with ب not redundant.
ITQAN:v3p103/r9.anchor: إطلاق الفاعل والمفعول على المصدر نحو ﴿ ليس لوقعتها ﴾ ﴿ كاذبة ﴾ ) أي تكذيب

RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r1.claim: Al-waqʿa signals a single occurrence: the event happens all at once, one time.
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r1.anchor: إشارة إلى أنها تقع دفعة واحدة فالوقعة للمرة الواحدة

RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r2.claim: Kādhiba may be an adjective for an omitted person or soul: no soul lies about its occurrence.
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r2.anchor: كاذبة صفة لمحذوف أقيمت مقامه تقديره ليس لها نفس تكذب

RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r3.claim: The feminine ending may instead intensify the noun, by the same account given for al-wāqiʿa.
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r3.anchor: الهاء للمبالغة كما تقول في الواقعة وقد تقدم بيانه

RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r4.claim: Kādhiba may be a verbal noun, like al-ʿāqiba.
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r4.anchor: هي مصدر كالعاقبة فإن قلنا بالوجه الأول فاللام تحتمل وجهين

RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r5.claim: With the lām causal, no one lies that day because its occurrence is so overwhelming; the denial is general.
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r5.anchor: لا تكذب نفس في ذلك اليوم لشدة وقعتها

RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r6.claim: The causal reading can also mean that no one can falsely claim there is no Resurrection, though people had denied it before.
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r6.anchor: لا يكذب أحد فيقول : لا قيامة

RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r7.claim: If the lām marks an object or relation, the sense is that no person can be found falsifying the Event when reporting it.
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r7.anchor: وذلك كما يقال : ليس لزيد ضارب

RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r8.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r8.claim: The idiom also rebukes someone who assumes a great undertaking is easy: the Event cannot be made easy by that claim.
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r8.anchor: ليس لها كاذب يقول : هي أمر سهل يطاق

RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r9.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r9.claim: On the intensive reading, no great liar can lie then, because the day's terror prevents it.
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r9.anchor: ليس لها كاذب عظيم بمعنى أن من يكذب ويقدم على الكذب العظيم لا يمكنه أن يكذب لهول ذلك اليوم

RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r10.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r10.claim: Alternatively, anyone denying the Event then would be an immense liar; Rāzī says the previous reading better conveys the day's terror.
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r10.anchor: أن أحدا لو كذب وقال في ذلك اليوم لا قيامة ولا واقعة لكان كاذبا عظيما

RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r11.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r11.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r11.claim: The first intensive interpretation better expresses the horror of the Day.

RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r12.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r12.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r12.claim: If kādhiba is a verbal noun, the verse means no one lies about the Day and everyone affirms it.
RAZI-FULL:v29p123#2/r12.anchor: يعود ما ذكرنا إلى أنه لا كاذب في ذلك اليوم بل كل أحد يصدقه

STUDYQURAN:56:1/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:1/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:56:1/r2.claim: Read continuously with verse 2, idhā forms an adverbial clause: when the Event occurs, none can deny its occurrence.
STUDYQURAN:56:1/r2.anchor: If it is read continuously with v. 2, it is considered an adverbial clause

STUDYQURAN:56:1/r6.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:1/r6.speaker: Q
STUDYQURAN:56:1/r6.claim: The Event overwhelms deniers so that none who denied it in life can deny it any longer.
STUDYQURAN:56:1/r6.anchor: It will be so overwhelming that none of those who denied it in this life will be able to deny it any longer (Q)

TAB-FULL:v22p279#2/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v22p279#2/r4.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v22p279#2/r4.claim: The Event cannot be denied, turned back, or repeated.
TAB-FULL:v22p279#2/r4.anchor: ليس لوقعة الواقعة تكذيب ولا مردودية ولا مثنوية

TAB-FULL:v22p279#2/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v22p279#2/r5.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v22p279#2/r5.claim: Here kādhiba is a verbal noun, like ʿāqiba and ʿāfiya.
TAB-FULL:v22p279#2/r5.anchor: والكاذبة في هذا الموضع مصدر، مثل العاقبة والعافية

TAB-FULL:v22p279#2/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v22p279#2/r6.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v22p279#2/r6.claim: Qatāda explains that the Event has no second occurrence, return, or reversal.
TAB-FULL:v22p279#2/r6.anchor: عن قتادة، {ليس لوقعتها كاذبة} [الواقعة: 2] «أي ليس لها مثنوية، ولا رجعة، ولا ارتداد»

BURSEVI:v9p257#3/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p257#3/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p257#3/r6.claim: At the Resurrection no one will lie about God by claiming partners, child, or spouse, or deny the raising of the dead; everyone will then believe and affirm, unlike most people today.
BURSEVI:v9p257#3/r6.anchor: لا يكون عند وقوعها نفس تكذب على الله وتفتري بالشريك والولد والصاحبة وبأنه لا يبعث الموتى

BURSEVI:v9p257#3/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p257#3/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p257#3/r7.claim: The lam may mark time, making the sense that no one lies when it occurs; alternatively it gives a causal sense, so nothing reported about it is false, and kādhiba is a verbal noun like ʿāqiba.
BURSEVI:v9p257#3/r7.anchor: فاللام للتوقيت والكاذبة اسم فاعل أوليس لأجل وقعتها أو في حقها كذب بل كل ما ورد في شأنها

TABATABAI:56:1-4/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:1-4/r6.speaker: المجمع
TABATABAI:56:1-4/r6.claim: Al-Majmaʿ treats kādhiba as a verbal noun like ʿāfiya and ʿāqiba, so there is no falsehood in the event’s coming to pass.
TABATABAI:56:1-4/r6.anchor: قال في المجمع الكاذبة مصدر كالعافية والعاقبة

TABATABAI:56:1-4/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:1-4/r7.speaker: author
TABATABAI:56:1-4/r7.claim: An alternative parses kādhiba as an adjective with an omitted noun: there is no false report or case concerning its occurrence.

TABRISI:56:2-4/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:56:2-4/r3.speaker: author
TABRISI:56:2-4/r3.claim: Kādhiba is a verbal noun, like ʿāfiya and ʿāqiba.
TABRISI:56:2-4/r3.anchor: الكاذبة مصدر مثل العافية والعاقبة والرج التحريك باضطراب واهتزاز

TABRISI:56:2-10/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:56:2-10/r3.speaker: author
TABRISI:56:2-10/r3.claim: Its arrival and manifestation are true, with no falsehood in the event, its report, or its occurrence.
TABRISI:56:2-10/r3.anchor: أي ليس لمجيئها وظهورها كذب ومعناه أنها تقع صدقا وحقا فليس فيها

TABRISI:56:2-10/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:56:2-10/r4.speaker: قول آخر
TABRISI:56:2-10/r4.claim: Another explanation is that no false case can be made about its occurrence, established by transmitted evidence and reason.
TABRISI:56:2-10/r4.anchor: وقيل: معناه ليس لوقوعها قضية كاذبة أي ثبت وقوعها بالسمع والعقل

THALABI:v9p199#3/r2.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p199#3/r2.speaker: سيبويه
THALABI:v9p199#3/r2.claim: Sībawayh takes كاذبة to mean denial: no one can deny the Event's occurrence.
THALABI:v9p199#3/r2.anchor: ليس لوقعتها كاذبة تكذيب ذكره سيبويه، وهو اسم

THALABI:v9p199#3/r3.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p199#3/r3.speaker: الفراء
THALABI:v9p199#3/r3.claim: Al-Farrāʾ treats كاذبة as a noun like عافية, نازلة, and عاقبة.
THALABI:v9p199#3/r3.anchor: وهو اسم كالعافية والنازلة والعاقبة، عن الفراء

THALABI:v9p199#3/r4.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p199#3/r4.speaker: الكسائي
THALABI:v9p199#3/r4.claim: Al-Kisāʾī says كاذبة means falsehood, like لاغية meaning لغوا in the verse about hearing no vain speech in Paradise.
THALABI:v9p199#3/r4.anchor: قال الكسائي: هي بمعنى الكذب كقوله لا تسمع فيها لاغية أي لغوا

THALABI:v9p199#3/r5.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p199#3/r5.speaker: author
THALABI:v9p199#3/r5.claim: Arabic can use the active participle قائما as a verbal noun meaning قياما, as a woman's lullaby illustrates.
THALABI:v9p199#3/r5.anchor: ولبعض نساء العرب ترقص ابنها: قم قائما قم قائما … أصبت عبدا نائما

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:56:1-10/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:56:1-10/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:56:1-10/r2.claim: There is no falsehood or denial concerning its coming.

QASHANI:56:1-3/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:56:1-3/r2.speaker: author
QASHANI:56:1-3/r2.claim: No soul can deny it, since each witnesses its own happiness or misery; the event lowers the wretched to depths and raises the fortunate to ranks.
QASHANI:56:1-3/r2.anchor: لأن كل نفس تشاهد أحوالها من السعادة والشقاوة

ELMALILI:56:1-24/r4.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r4.speaker: author
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r4.claim: He prefers the apparent construction in which verse 2 supplies the answer to the conditional in verse 1.
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r4.anchor: zâhir olan cevap şudur: {لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ}

ELMALILI:56:1-24/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r5.claim: One rendering says no person will call the Resurrection’s occurrence false.

ELMALILI:56:1-24/r6.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r6.speaker: author
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r6.claim: Alternatively, nothing false attaches to its occurrence.

ELMALILI:56:1-24/r7.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r7.speaker: author
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r7.claim: Wuqūʿ means falling; waqʿa is the noun for one forceful fall, later used for a great blow or crisis and sometimes specifically for war.
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r7.anchor: düşmek demek olduğu gibi, esasen “vak‘a” da masdar binâ-i merre olarak şiddetle bir düşüş demektir.

ELMALILI:56:1-24/r8.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r8.speaker: author
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r8.claim: People may deny Resurrection before it comes, but once it occurs no one can deny it; all must affirm it and cannot escape its impact and upheaval.
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r8.anchor: kıyamet kopmadan evvel onu tekzib ve inkâr edenler bulunursa da onun vukū‘u tahakkuk edip bir kere olacak oldu mu artık onu kimse inkâr edemez

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:1/r9.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:1/r9.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:1/r9.claim: Depending on the syntactic role assigned to kadhība, verse 2 can mean that no one can deny the event's occurrence or that its occurrence is no lie.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:1/r9.anchor: kâzibe kelimesinin cümledeki görevini farklı değerlendirerek “onun oluşu asla yalan değildir” anlamı da verilebilmektedir

QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r3.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r3.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r3.claim: When the Resurrection occurs, nothing can repel it.
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r3.anchor: إذا قامت القيامة لا يردها شيء

QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r4.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r4.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r4.claim: Kādhiba is a verbal noun like ʿāfiya and ʿāqiba; the event is true and cannot be turned back, with no falsehood in its coming.
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r4.anchor: أي : هي حقة لا يدرها شيء ، وليس في وقوعها كذب

QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r5.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r5.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r5.claim: The person on the path of soundness and uprightness reaches safety and honor; whoever deviates meets regret and loss, and the event distinguishes truth from pretense.
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r5.anchor: ويقال : إذا وقعت الواقعة فمن سلك منهاج الصحة والاستقامة وصل إلى السلامة ولقي الكرامة

QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r6.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r6.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r6.claim: A poem says that when tears mingle on faces, one can distinguish a genuine mourner from someone pretending to weep.
QUSHAYRI:v3p273/r6.anchor: إذا اشتبكت دموع في خدود . . . تبين من بكى ممن تباكى

BURHAN:v2p285/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p285/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p285/r1.claim: In “its occurrence has no kādhiba,” the active participle stands for the verbal noun takdhīb, meaning denial.
BURHAN:v2p285/r1.anchor: ومنها اقامة الفاعل مقام المصدر نحو

BURHAN:v2p285/r5.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p285/r5.speaker: الفارسي
BURHAN:v2p285/r5.claim: Al-Farisi says a passive meaning does not change the pronoun's raising: in a form shaped as an active participle it follows the active-participle pattern.
BURHAN:v2p285/r5.anchor: قال أبو الفتح في كتابه هذا الفد وسألته يعني الفارسي اذا جعلت فاعلا بمعنى مفعول

DAMGHANI:v1p493/r5.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p493/r5.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p493/r5.claim: وقع can mean arose or came to pass; the Occurrence is the Resurrection, and its occurrence means its rising.
DAMGHANI:v1p493/r5.anchor: وقعت أي قامت قوله تعالى في سورة الواقعة إذا وقعت الواقعة أي قامت القيامة ليس لوقعتها أي لقيامتها

DAMGHANI:v1p401/r8.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p401/r8.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p401/r8.claim: كاذبة can mean a denial or rejection of the Resurrection's occurrence.
DAMGHANI:v1p401/r8.anchor: الرابع : الكذب الرد قوله تعالى في سورة الواقعة

FARRA:v3p121/r1.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p121/r1.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p121/r1.claim: There is no repelling or turning back of the Event; كاذبة is a verbal noun like العاقبة and العافية.
FARRA:v3p121/r1.anchor: يقول: ليس لها مردودة ولا رد، فالكاذبة هاهنا مصدر مثل: العاقبة، والعافية.

FARRA:v3p121/r2.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p121/r2.speaker: أبو ثروان
FARRA:v3p121/r2.claim: Abu Tharwan's phrase بني نمير ليس لحدهم مكذوبة means their boundary suffers no denial, using مكذوبة for تكذيب.
FARRA:v3p121/r2.anchor: وقال لي أبو ثروان في كلامه: إن بني نمير ليس لحدهم مكذوبة

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p445#3/r1.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p445#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p445#3/r1.claim: There is no repelling or turning back of the Event; in Arabic, one attacked and “did not lie” when he did not retreat.
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p445#3/r1.anchor: {ليس لوقعتها كاذبة} أي ليس لها مردود (2) . يقال: حمل عليه فما كذب؛ أي فما رجع.

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p445#3/r2.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p445#3/r2.speaker: أبو ثروان
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p445#3/r2.claim: Al-Farrāʾ reports Abū Tharwān’s idiom that Banū Numayr’s fighting edge has no denial or rebuttal.
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p445#3/r2.anchor: قال الفراء (3) : "قال لي أبو ثروان: إن بني نمير ليس لحدهم مكذوبة؛ أي تكذيب".

MAJAZ:v2p247/r2.author: Abū ʿUbayda Maʿmar b. al-Muthannā
MAJAZ:v2p247/r2.speaker: author
MAJAZ:v2p247/r2.claim: He attaches khāfiḍatan rāfiʿatan to the earlier statement; if it continued the later clause, it would be accusative. Arabic can shift repeated news from accusative to nominative, as in 70:15–17 and the anonymous rajaz verse.
MAJAZ:v2p247/r2.anchor: العرب إذا كرروا الأخبار وأعادوها أخرجوها من النصب إلى الرفع فرفعوا،

NAHHAS:v4p321/r7.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p321/r7.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p321/r7.claim: Kādhibatun is the subject of laysa; most grammarians treat it as an abstract noun meaning falsehood, as in ʿāqiba and ʿāfiya.
NAHHAS:v4p321/r7.anchor: اسم ليس وذكرت كاذبة عند أكثر النحويين لأنها بمعنى الكذب أي ليس لوقعتها كذب قال الفراء مثل عاقبة وعافية

SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r5.claim: لوقعتها is the fronted predicate and كاذبة the delayed subject; كاذبة apparently modifies an omitted noun.
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r5.anchor: و " كاذبة " يجوز أن يكون اسم فاعل وهو الظاهر، وهو صفة لمحذوف

SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r6.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r6.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī supplies نفس as omitted noun: no one lies about God or denies Resurrection; he compares the lām to 89:24.
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r6.anchor: فقدره الزمخشري: " نفس كاذبة، أي: إنه ذلك اليوم لا يكذب على الله أحد

SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r7.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r7.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī also reads the phrase through the idiom of a soul urging someone to face danger; here no soul urges endurance, leaving people weak like moths.
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r7.anchor: أو هو من قولهم: كذبت فلانا نفسه في الخطر العظيم إذا شجعته

SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r8.speaker: ابن عطية
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r8.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya supplies حال كاذبة; one interpretation is that the event is falsely denied or called false.
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r8.anchor: وقدره ابن عطية: " حال كاذبة " قال: " ويحتمل الكلام على هذا معنيين، أحدهما: كاذبة

SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r9.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r9.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya’s second gloss is that the event’s coming does not fail, as when one says a promiser does not lie.
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r9.anchor: وقدره ابن عطية: " حال كاذبة " قال: " ويحتمل الكلام على هذا معنيين

SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r10.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r10.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r10.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī treats كاذبة as a verbal noun for تكذيب, like خائنة الأعين, and cites an idiom for not faltering against a foe.
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r10.anchor: والثاني: أن كاذبة مصدر بمعنى التكذيب نحو: خائنة الأعين. قال الزمخشري: " من قولك حمل فلان على قرنه فما كذب

SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r11.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r11.speaker: زهير
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r11.claim: Zuhayr’s line uses كذب for not faltering before opponents, supporting the idiomatic sense.
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#2/r11.anchor:
وأنشد لزهير:
4200 ليث بعثر يصطاد الرجال إذا
ما الليث كذب عن أقرانه صدقا

SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#3/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#3/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#3/r2.claim: The clause may have no syntactic position, as an opening or interpolation between condition and omitted answer.
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#3/r2.anchor: أحدهما: أنها لا محل لها من الإعراب: إما لأنها ابتدائية ولا سيما على رأي الزمخشري

SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#3/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#3/r3.speaker: ابن عطية
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#3/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya assigns the clause accusative as a circumstantial clause.
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#3/r3.anchor: والثاني: أن محلها النصب على الحال، قاله ابن عطية، ولم يبين صاحب الحال ماذا؟

SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#3/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#3/r4.speaker: أبو الفضل
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#3/r4.claim: Abū al-Faḍl identifies الواقعة as the subject of the circumstantial clause.
SAMIN-DURR:56:1-2#3/r4.anchor: وهو واضح إذا لم يكن هنا إلا الواقعة، وقد صرح أبو الفضل بذلك.

ZAJJAJ:v5p107/r7.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p107/r7.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p107/r7.claim: Nothing can turn the event away, like a person's carrying that cannot be turned back.
ZAJJAJ:v5p107/r7.anchor: أي لا يردها شيء كما تقول: قد حمل فلان لا يكذب، أي لايرد حملته شيء

ZAJJAJ:v5p107/r8.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p107/r8.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p107/r8.claim: Kādhiba is a verbal noun, like ʿāfiya and ʿāqiba; these are nouns used in place of verbal nouns.
ZAJJAJ:v5p107/r8.anchor: مصدر كقولك [عافاه] الله عافية وعاقبه عاقبة، وكذلك كذب كاذبة، وهذه أسماء في موضع المصادر

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p269/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p269/r1.speaker: قتادة
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p269/r1.claim: Qatāda glosses the event's having no “kādhiba” with the word “mathnūya,” indicating no turning back or denial of its occurrence.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p269/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله تعالى ﴿ إذا وقعت الواقعة ﴾ قال نزلت ﴿ ليس لوقعتها كاذبة ﴾ قال مثنوية

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p75/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p75/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p75/r8.claim: Abū Ḥayyān rejects laysa as the governor: it has no event or time, so it cannot govern a temporal adverb; in the Friday example, the preposed predicate governs the phrase.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p75/r8.anchor: أما نصبها بليس فلا يذهب نحوي ولا من شدا شيئا من صناعة الإعراب إلى مثل هذا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r3.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r3.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī takes kādhiba as an active participle modifying an omitted nafs: at the Resurrection no soul will lie about God or deny the unseen, and all will believe.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r3.anchor: وكاذبة: ظاهره أنه اسم فاعل من كذب، وهو صفة لمحذوف، فقدره الزمخشري: نفس كاذبة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r4.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r4.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī supports the claim that people then believe by citing their profession of faith when they see punishment, delayed belief until painful torment, and continued doubt until the Hour.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r4.anchor: لقوله تعالى: فلما رأوا بأسنا قالوا آمنا بالله وحده

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r5.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r5.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī compares the absence of a soul that reproaches its owner then with the soul’s present reproach in the phrase ‘if only I had sent ahead for my life.’
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r5.anchor: واللام مثلها في قوله: يا ليتني قدمت لحياتي ، إذ ليس لها نفس تكذبها

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r6.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r6.claim: A second Zamakhsharī explanation invokes the idiom that a person’s soul lies to him by urging him to face a grave ordeal; at the Resurrection no soul can reassure its owner that he can endure it, for people will be weak and abased.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r6.anchor: أو هي من قولهم: كذبت فلانا نفسه في الخطب العظيم، إذا شجعته على مباشرته

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r7.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r7.claim: Abū Ḥayyān criticizes al-Zamakhsharī’s treatment as excessive elaboration.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r8.speaker: ابن عطية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r8.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya parses kādhiba as a circumstantial expression: either the event is falsely reported, or its occurrence does not fail, as in the phrase about a person carrying a load without failing.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p76/r8.anchor: وقدره ابن عطية حال كاذبة، قال: ويحتمل الكلام على هذا معنيين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r1.speaker: قتادة والحسن
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r1.claim: Qatāda and al-Ḥasan take kādhiba as an abstract noun: the event has no denial, rejection, or falsification.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r1.anchor: وقال قتادة والحسن المعنى: ليس لها تكذيب ولا رد ولا منثوية

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r2.speaker: قتادة والحسن
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r2.claim: On their reading, kādhiba is a verbal noun like ʿāqiba, ʿāfiya, and khāʾinat al-aʿyun.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r2.anchor: فكاذبة على هذا مصدر، كالعاقبة والعافية وخائنة الأعين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r3.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r3.claim: For al-Zamakhsharī, the sentence begins the sūra if idhā is governed by laysa; it is not an opening if treated as the conditional answer or if idhā is an object of udhkur.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r3.anchor: على ما قدره الزمخشري من أن إذا معمولة لليس يكون ابتداء السورة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r4.speaker: ابن عطية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya treats the sentence as a circumstantial clause.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r4.anchor: وقال ابن عطية: في موضع الحال، والذي يظهر لي أنها جملة اعتراض بين الشرط

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r5.claim: Abū Ḥayyān’s own analysis is that it is a parenthesis between the condition and its response.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r5.anchor: والذي يظهر لي أنها جملة اعتراض بين الشرط وجوابه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r6.speaker: أبو الفضل الرازي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r6.claim: Abū al-Faḍl al-Rāzī says al-wāqiʿa is the circumstantial referent governed by waqaʿat; laysa li-waqʿatihā kādhiba can be a further circumstantial description, yielding three states of one referent.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r6.anchor: وهذا الذي قاله سبقه إليه أبو الفضل الرازي. قال في كتاب اللوامح: وذو الحال الواقعة والعامل وقعت

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r7.speaker: أبو الفضل الرازي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r7.claim: If all are circumstantial clauses, al-Rāzī says the governor of idhā waqaʿat is omitted and inferred from the context, such as yuḥāsabūn, ‘they are judged.’
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r7.anchor: وإذا جعلت هذه كلها أحوالا، كان العامل في إذا وقعت محذوفا يدل عليه الفحوى بتقدير يحاسبون ونحوه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r8.claim: The classification and number of circumstantial clauses or predicates are disputed and not agreed by grammarians.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p77/r8.anchor: وتعداد الأحوال والأخبار فيه خلاف وتفصيل ذكر في النحو، فليس ذلك مما أجمع عليه النحاة

ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r1.speaker: ابن عطية
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r1.claim: Ibn Atiyya takes the clause either as a parenthesis confirming the Event’s certainty or as a circumstantial clause describing it.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r1.anchor: إما اعتراض يؤكد تحقيق الوقوع أو حال من الواقعة كما قال ابن عطية

ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r2.claim: كاذبة is an active participle modifying an omitted noun, preferably نفس rather than مقالة, because people are more commonly described as liars than statements are.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r2.anchor: و ( كاذبة ) اسم فاعل وقع صفة لموصوف محذوف أي نفس

ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r3.claim: الواقعة literally means a forceful fall, became a common term for a momentous event, and can also be used specifically for war; here it refers to the Resurrection.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r3.anchor: و ( الواقعة ) السقطة القوية وشاعت في وقوعالأمر العظيم وقد تخص بالحرب

ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r4.claim: The lām marks time: when the Event occurs, no soul remains to deny God’s report; current deniers will then acknowledge it as true.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r4.anchor: واللام للتوقيت مثلها في قولك : كتبته لخمس خلوان

ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r5.claim: Another reading means that no one lies about anything on that day; its soundness depends on holding that no one lies then and explaining the deniers’ oath elsewhere.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r5.anchor: وقيل : على معنى ليس في وقت وقوعها نفس كاذبة في شيء من الأشياء

ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r6.claim: On another reading, no one denies the Event or asks the Hour why it came, whereas people deluded by worldly attractions implicitly deny it now.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r6.anchor: و ( كاذبة ) صفة لذلك المحذوف أيضا

ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r7.claim: Addressing the Hour as if someone could ask it why it came is a representational metaphor, either imagined or taken literally.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r7.anchor: وفيه استعارة تمثيلية لأن الساعة لا تصلح مخاطبا

ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r8.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r8.claim: كاذبة may derive from كذبت نفسه or كذبته, when one’s self deceives, indulges distant hopes, and emboldens a person to attempt a great undertaking.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r8.anchor: وجوز كون ( كاذبة ) منقولهم كذبت نفسه وكذبته

ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r9.speaker: الكشف
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r9.claim: Al-Kashf says the lām in that interpretation also marks time: no self will encourage its owner to think it can endure the Event’s severity.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r9.anchor: وفي الكشف إن اللام على هذا الوجه للتوقيت كما في الوجه الأول

ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r10.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r10.claim: كاذبة may be a verbal noun meaning discouragement or holding back: the Event has no retreat, like a truthful assault by a powerful fighter.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r10.anchor: وجوز أيضا كون ( كاذبة ) مصدرا بمعنى التكذيب وهو التثبيط

ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r11.speaker: الحسن، قتادة
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r11.claim: A similar explanation is transmitted from al-Hasan and Qatadah.

ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r12.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r12.speaker: زهير
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r12.claim: Zuhayr’s line uses كذب for a lion holding back from its peers, supporting the sense of refraining or retreating.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r12.anchor: لزهير : ليث بعثر يصطاد الرجال إذا ماالليث ( كذب

ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r13.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r13.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r13.claim: The author finds it clearer to take كاذبة as the Event’s falsehood or denial: its occurrence is true and beyond doubt, like a true assault.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r13.anchor: ويجوز جعل الكاذبة بمعنى الكذب للوقعة

ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r14.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r14.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r14.claim: He likewise finds clearer the sense that the Event is not false in its occurrence but is truth without ambiguity, despite this sense also being narrated from al-Hasan and Qatadah.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r14.anchor: أو على معنى ليس هي في وقوعها كذب

ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r15.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r15.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r15.claim: A reservation about the preferred verbal-noun interpretation is that the pattern فاعلة is rare for a verbal noun.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p129#2/r15.anchor: نعم قيل : عليها إن مجيء المصدر على زنة الفاعل نادر

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p7#4/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p7#4/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p7#4/r3.claim: Nothing false can be said of its coming: it will truly and certainly occur; the author compares 88:11, where no vain speech is heard.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p7#4/r3.anchor: {ليس لوقعتها} لمجيئها {كاذبة} كذب كقوله: "لا تسمع فيها لاغية" (الغاشية -11) أي: لغو يعني أنها تقع صدقا وحقا.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p7#4/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p7#4/r4.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p7#4/r4.claim: Kādhiba is a noun, like ʿāfiya and nāzila.

BAYDAWI-FULL:56:1-3/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:1-3/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:1-3/r3.claim: At its occurrence, no one lies about God or denies the event as people deny it now; the lām works as in the cited verse.
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:1-3/r3.anchor: لا يكون حين تقع نفس تكذب على الله تعالى

BAYDAWI-FULL:56:1-3/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:1-3/r4.speaker: قيل
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:1-3/r4.claim: Alternatively, no one can lie about its occurrence: anyone who reports it now speaks truth, or no inner voice will falsely reassure a person that he can bear its severity.
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:1-3/r4.anchor: أو ليس لأحد في وقعتها كاذبة فإنه من أخبر عنها صدق

BAYDAWI-FULL:56:1-3/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:1-3/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:1-3/r5.claim: The phrase can describe a person's soul falsely encouraging him about a great ordeal and persuading him he can endure it.
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:1-3/r5.anchor: من قولهم: كذبت فلانا نفسه في الخطب العظيم

BIQAI-FULL:v7p402#2/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p402#2/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p402#2/r5.claim: Its occurrence is utterly certain: nothing in its circumstances can be called false, and no falsehood will prevail there; every promised event arrives and every denied event remains absent.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p402#2/r5.anchor: بل كل ما أخبر بمجيئه جاء من غير أن يرده شيء

DURR-FULL:v8p3/r12.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p3/r12.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p3/r12.claim: Ibn Abbas says there is no return that can turn back its occurrence.
DURR-FULL:v8p3/r12.anchor: عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما في قوله: {إذا وقعت الواقعة} قال: يوم القيامة {ليس لوقعتها كاذبة} قال: ليس لها مرد يرد

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r4.claim: Al-kadhiba may be an active participle of intransitive kadhiba, with a suppressed feminine nafs: no soul will deny or lie about the Resurrection once it occurs.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r4.anchor: جرى على التأنيث للدلالة على أنه وصف لمحذوف مؤنث اللفظ

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r5.claim: On that reading, deniers claim the Resurrection will not occur, but when it happens every soul will believe it and none will still deny it or lie about it.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r5.anchor: وذلك أن منكري القيامة يقولون : لا تقع القيامة فيكذبون في ذلك فإذا وقعت آمنت النفوس كلها بوقوعها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r6.claim: Alternatively, kadhiba derives from transitive kadhdhaba: a person's own mind can tell a false story, as when misplaced confidence encourages a person to undertake what they cannot do.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r6.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون من كذب المتعدي مثل الذي في قولهم كذبت فلانا نفسه ، أي حدثته نفسه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r7.claim: The sense of self-deception is illustrated by saying a person's eye deceived them when they thought they saw what was not there.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r7.anchor: كما يقال : كذبته عينه إذا تخيل مرئيا ولم يكن .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r8.claim: The verse warns deniers that the Resurrection will prove their error, leaving them disgraced and foolish in the assembly of the gathered.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p281/r8.anchor: والمعنى : إذا وقعت القيامة تحقق منكروها ذلك فأقلعوا عن اعتقادهم أنها لا تقع

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r1.claim: Calling a failed cause a lie extends the word metaphorically: Abu Ali al-Farisi says lying is a kind of speech, and Arabic can attribute speech or lying to something that does not speak.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r1.anchor: وإطلاق وصف الكذب في جميع هذا استعارة بتشبيه السبب للفعل غير المثمر بالمخبر بحديث كذب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r2.speaker: أبو علي الفارسي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r2.claim: Abu Ali al-Farisi adduces Abu al-Najm's line in which the girths speak to a belly as an example of extended speech for a non-speaking thing.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r2.anchor: قال أبو علي الفارسي : الكذب ضرب من القول فكما جاز أن يتسع في القول في غير نطق نحو قول أبي النجم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r3.speaker: أبو علي الفارسي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r3.claim: Abu Ali also cites the phrase about garments lying as an example of using falsehood beyond literal speech.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r3.anchor: جاز في الكذب أن يجعل في غير نطق نحو : بأن كذب القراطف والقروف

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r4.claim: The lām in liwaq'atiha marks time, like the lām in commands to pray at the sun's decline and to divorce for the waiting period; this grew from lām of specification.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r4.anchor: واللام في { لوقعتها } لام التوقيت نحو { أقم الصلاة لدلوك الشمس } ( الإسراء : 78 )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r5.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r5.claim: The Prophet identifies prayer at its proper time as the best deed, illustrating the temporal use of the lām; no grading is stated.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r5.anchor: وفي الحديث سئل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ( أي الأعمال أفضل فقال : الصلاة لوقتها )

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r6.claim: The time-lām in this verse is different from the construction in the statement that the damned have no food except dar'i.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p282/r6.anchor: وهذا الاستعمال غير الاستعمال الذي في قوله تعالى : { ليس لهم طعام إلا من ضريع }

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r4.speaker: قتادة والحسن
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r4.claim: Qatāda and al-Ḥasan take كاذبة as a verbal noun: the event cannot be denied or reversed.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r4.anchor: فالمعنى ليس لها تكذيب ولا رد مثنوية، وهذا قول قتادة والحسن

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r5.claim: Alternatively, كاذبة modifies an omitted حال: no state of occurrence is false, because its report is true or its happening cannot fail.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r5.anchor: ويحتمل أن يكون صفة لمقدر، كأنه قال: ليس لوقعتها حال كاذبة، ويحتمل الكلام على هذا معنيين

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r6.claim: One omitted-state sense is a report that is not false.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r6.anchor: أحدهما كاذبة، أي مكذوب فيما أخبر به عنها فسماها كاذبة بهذا، كما تقول هذه قصة كاذبة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r7.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r7.claim: The other sense is that the event's occurrence will not fail, as one says a person does not fail when undertaking a task.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p238#2/r7.anchor: والثاني حالة كاذبة أي لا يمضي وقوعها، كما تقول: فلان إذا حمل لم يكذب

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r1.claim: For its occurrence, kādhiba means a lie or denial; the phrase refers to its appearing and coming, as in the description ‘no idle speech’ in 88:11.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r1.anchor: ليس لوقعتها أي لظهورها ومجيئها كاذبة أي كذب كقوله لا تسمع فيها لاغية

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r2.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r2.claim: Al-Zajjāj treats kādhiba as a verbal noun, like ʿāfiya in ‘God healed him with healing’ and kādhiba in ‘a lie.’
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r2.anchor: قال الزجاج وكاذبة مصدر كقولك عافاه الله عافية وكذب كاذبة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r3.speaker: قتادة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r3.claim: Qatāda says the event has no reversal or turning back.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r3.anchor: أحدهما لا رجعة لها ولا ارتداد قاله قتادة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r4.speaker: المواردي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r4.claim: Al-Māwardī explains that the report of its occurrence is not false.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p131/r4.anchor: والثاني ليس الإخبار عن وقوعها كذبا حكاه المواردي

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r2.claim: When God wills the Event to occur, nothing can turn it aside or repel it; compare 42:47, 70:1–2, and 6:73.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r2.anchor: وقوله: {ليس لوقعتها كاذبة} أي: ليس لوقوعها إذا أراد الله كونها

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r3.speaker: محمد بن كعب
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r3.claim: Muhammad ibn Kab glosses kadhiba as meaning that the Event must happen.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r3.anchor: ومعنى {كاذبة} -كما قال محمد بن كعب-: لا بد أن تكون

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r4.speaker: قتادة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r4.claim: Qatada explains that the Event has no reversal, retreat, or return.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r4.anchor: وقال قتادة: ليس فيها مثنوية ولا ارتداد ولا رجعة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r5.speaker: ابن جرير
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r5.claim: Al-Tabari analyzes kadhiba as a verbal noun, like al-aqiba and al-afiya.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p513#2/r5.anchor: قال ابن جرير: والكاذبة: مصدر كالعاقبة والعافية

JISHUMI:v9p6737/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6737/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6737/r10.claim: One parsing makes كاذبة an adjective of an omitted noun, meaning no false case in the Event; another takes it as a verbal noun meaning no lying in its report.
JISHUMI:v9p6737/r10.anchor: كاذبة نعت لمحذوف، أي: ليس قضية كاذبة فيها، ويجوز: ليس لها تعيين كاذبة في الخبر بها

JISHUMI:v9p6737/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6737/r11.speaker: الكسائي
JISHUMI:v9p6737/r11.claim: Al-Kisāʾī treats كاذبة as a verbal noun like lāghiya or khāʾina; the sense is that the Event contains no falsehood but is true.
JISHUMI:v9p6737/r11.anchor: وقيل: الكاذبة مصدر، كما يقال: لاغية، أي: لغو، وخائنة، أي: خيانة عن الكسائي

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r3.claim: One view says no soul will deny God or the unseen then: all will believe truly, unlike people now who deny until punishment appears.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r3.anchor: أي : لا تكون حين تقع نفس تكذب على الله

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r4.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r4.claim: Alternatively no soul will deny the Event or tell itself that it will never happen, as many do now.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r4.anchor: أو : ليس لها نفس تكذبها وتقول لها : لم تكوني

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r5.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r5.claim: Another sense is self-encouragement in a terrible trial; then people will be too weak to reassure themselves that they can endure it, like scattered moths.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r5.anchor: أو هي من قولهم : كذبت فلانا نفسه في الخطب العظيم

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r6.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r6.claim: Alternatively كاذبة is a verbal noun meaning denial or cowardice, as in حمل على قرنه فما كذب; Zuhayr's line witnesses this usage.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p454/r6.anchor: وقيل : { كاذبة } مصدر كالعاقبة بمعنى التكذيب

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p445#2/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p445#2/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p445#2/r5.claim: The event has no possibility of being turned back.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p445#2/r5.anchor: ليس لها مردود , قاله ابن عباس

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p445#2/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p445#2/r6.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p445#2/r6.claim: There is no return from it and no consultation about it.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p445#2/r6.anchor: لا رجعة فيها ولا مشورة , قاله قتادة

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p445#2/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p445#2/r7.speaker: ابن كامل
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p445#2/r7.claim: No believer or unbeliever can deny that it occurs.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p445#2/r7.anchor: ليس لها مكذب من مؤمن ولا من كافر , قاله ابن كامل

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p445#2/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p445#2/r8.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p445#2/r8.claim: Alternatively, the report that it will occur is not false.

MUQATIL:56:1-2/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:56:1-2/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:56:1-2/r2.claim: The cry's coming is certain, with no second occurrence or turning back.
MUQATIL:56:1-2/r2.anchor: { ليس لوقعتها } يعني ليس لصيحتها { كاذبة } [آية: 2]

NASAFI-FULL:v4p206#2/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p206#2/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p206#2/r1.claim: No soul will then deny Allah or the unseen; every soul will believe and affirm, unlike the many lying deniers today.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p206#2/r1.anchor: نفس كاذبة اى لا تكون حين تقع نفس تكذيب على الله وتكذب في تكذيب الغيب لان كل نفس حينئذ مؤمنة صادقة مصدقة

NASAFI-FULL:v4p206#2/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p206#2/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p206#2/r2.claim: The lām has the same usage as in “If only I had sent ahead for my life” (89:24).
NASAFI-FULL:v4p206#2/r2.anchor: واللام مثلها في قوله تعالى يا ليتنى قدمت لحياتى

QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r7.speaker: الكسائي
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r7.claim: Kādhiba is a verbal noun meaning denial or falsehood; Arabic can use an active or passive participle as a verbal noun, as in 88:11.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r7.anchor: الكاذبة مصدر بمعنى الكذب، والعرب قد تضع الفاعل والمفعول موضع المصدر

QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r8.claim: Everyday expressions such as ʿāʾidhan bi-llāh and qāʾiman for qiyāman illustrate the verbal-noun usage; an Arab woman's rhyme uses qāʾiman too.

QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r9.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r9.claim: Kādhiba can be an adjective with an omitted noun: no false state or person will accompany the Event, so all reports of it are true.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r9.anchor: وقيل: الكاذبة صفة والموصوف محذوف، أي ليس لوقعتها حال كاذبة أو نفس كاذبة

QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r10.speaker: الزجاج والحسن وقتادة
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r10.claim: Al-Zajjāj, al-Ḥasan, and Qatāda explain that nothing can repel the Event.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r10.anchor: وقال الزجاج: «ليس لوقعتها كاذبة» أي لا يردها شيء. ونحوه قول الحسن وقتادة.

QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r11.speaker: الثوري
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r11.claim: Al-Thawrī says no one will deny that the Event occurs.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r11.anchor: وقال الثوري: ليس لوقعتها أحد يكذب بها

QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r12.speaker: الكسائي
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r12.claim: Al-Kisāʾī also understands the verse to mean that no denial of it should occur.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r12.anchor: وقال الكسائي أيضا: ليس لها تكذيب أي ينبغي ألا يكذب بها أحد

QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r13.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r13.claim: Another explanation stresses that the Resurrection is serious, with no jest in it.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:1-3/r13.anchor: وقيل: إن قيامها جد لا هزل فيه
